title: Northrop Grumman / Area 51 ARV story called a myth

tellings.quote: I said so what's the story about North or gemman had having an arv or somebody out at Area 51 having an arv and he said oh that's all myth

related.note: The same subject as Lazar's claim of an ARV being reverse-engineered at Area 51, but this source calls the ARV story a myth, so the core claim conflicts with Lazar's.

plain: The stories that the defense company Northrop Grumman, or someone at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, has an ARV, an alien reproduction vehicle, a man-made craft copied from a recovered one, are "all myth." Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has advised the Pentagon, says that is the answer a source gave when he asked, a story linked to the claims of Bob Lazar, a man who said he worked on alien craft near Area 51.
